title: Hip-Hop Artist Phundo Art Captures Futurism and Authenticity Through Digital Art
htmlContent:
Uk-based South African artist Phundo Art is a rapper and poetic genius currently making waves with his recent song, “Race.” The talented rapper records his music and plays in amazing shows all around Uk, and he is currently gaining a close community of fans.

Phundo Art raps about his experiences in life, and he uses them as an insight into his life and manifestation. Phundo Art’s “Race” is a significant time-writing that hits as he delivers it for the world to enjoy majorly and learn from his past relationship.
